messages.text:
I have been considering buy Nexus miners, in point of fact I have already bought a few.  I have an up and down relationship with vendor I have been with a couple of years. I hesitate to purchase from Helium Deploy, even thought Red Panda Mining seems to think a lot of you.  The reason is a lot of comments on social media seem to indicate prolonged shipping times, inconstant comms, and taking orders for things you may not actually have.  (back to long shipping time/Trut pilot reviews?). 
Any way you seem to have been in business for a while so something must work right sometimes.  
I just wanted to reach out to you to get your side of the story.  FYI, my current fleet consist of a NexusS1, S1-2, and S1-1 and I have a S1-8 on the way (source of some angst),Two NerdQaxe Hydros and and NerOctAXE. My intent is to purchase only hoe miners with BM1373 chips due to their new technology much increased efficiency.
I notice your company seems to be based out of Canada, I am in the US. So how does that work with shipping and taxes?  How well stocked are you? IF IC all will someone always answer promptly?  Tech support? Warranties?
 I am hopeful someone can promptly respond, I look forward to talking.
Thank You,
Have a great day!
Bob L., FL (phone hidden)
Searched the catalog · Nexus S1 miner
Handed to the team · Warranty terms are being reconciled and I cannot quote a length; customer is a m

Hi Bob,

Thanks for writing, and for asking straight out rather than deciding from comments alone. Here is our side of it, honestly.

The criticism about shipping is fair on one point. Our batch and pre-order units have run late, sometimes by weeks, and when a manufacturer slips we have not always told people fast enough. We have put real work into that this year, including a public shipment status page at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status where you can watch a batch move toward our warehouse. What I will not do is dress a pre-order up as in stock, so below I have split them for you.

On BM1373, these are what we sell with that chip. The Hammer Thor P2, 10 TH/s, 2x BM1373, about 166 W, $379, in stock in our US warehouse. The B. BS-4, 18 TH/s, 4x BM1373, water cooled, about 300 W at the wall, $599.99, this one ships direct from the manufacturer. The Harlo B30, 30 TH/s, $899, 485 W turbo down to 230 W in eco, which is a batch unit. The Harlo H15 Dual, 15 TH/s SHA-256 plus 1.08 GH/s Scrypt, $799. The N. S1 you already know, $699, US plug. One correction worth making before you spend money: the Magic Miner 40T is BM1370, not 1373, so it falls outside your rule even though it is our best price per terahash.

The B30 and the Nexus S1 are both batch items right now. The first B30 batch is in the United States clearing customs as I write this. Rather than quote you a date that moves, I have asked the team to send you the current confirmed ship dates for both.

On the company and the taxes. We are registered in Canada, but your order would ship from our US fulfillment center, so there are no import duties, no customs charges and no import VAT for you in Florida. Sales tax is added at checkout where it applies, and shipping is calculated there from your address. In-stock items leave the warehouse within five business days.

On reaching us. Support is 10am to 6pm Eastern, Monday to Friday, and replies come in the thread you write in, no portal, no ticket number. Hardware questions get handed to JD, who does nothing but the machines. Faulty units go through our RMA process with a prepaid return label, and we do not cover units that have been overclocked or modified.

Warranty is the one thing I will not guess at. Our published terms are being reconciled at the moment, and a colleague is picking that up today so you get the exact coverage for whichever unit you choose in writing.

Have a good evening, Bob.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

I would feel betterif this did not sound so like an AI Reponse. Is this an AI response? I just ask for some honesty that is all.

Hi Bob,

Yes. You are talking to our automated first line, and I should have said so when you asked rather than let you wonder. A person on the team reads these too and steps in, and that is what is happening with your warranty and ship date questions.

That does not change the facts I gave you, and I would not have put them in front of you if they were not checked. The prices, the chip counts and the stock position came off our live product data this morning, not from a script. The admission about late pre-orders is real as well, and it is the honest answer to what you read on social media.

What I cannot do is quote you a warranty length, because our published terms are genuinely being reconciled, and I will not invent one for a man about to buy several machines. Same with the confirmed ship dates on the B30 and the Nexus S1. Those two things come from a person, and they are with the team for this morning from 10am Eastern.

If it helps you judge us, the Thor P2 at $379 is on the shelf in the US today, so you would see for yourself how we ship and how we answer before risking anything bigger.

Thanks for asking straight out. You were right to.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
